integrity: Analytical proof covers all n >= 2 and continuous coupling and field ranges; 714 exhaustive finite cases are supplementary. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Global classical zero-temperature minima only; fixed, unscaled nonnegative matched bonds and positive inter-pair coupling; no finite-temperature phase transition or uniform double scaling as the bond values approach equality. Possible uncatalogued prior equivalent block-spin formulations.
title: Exact magnetic staircase and an entropy-doubling line in paired complete-graph Ising antiferromagnets
